releaseNotes: NChat 1.0.67 — an emoji button in the composer. (1) There is now a smiley beside the text field: tap it and a panel opens above the message box with six categories — smileys, gestures, hearts, animals, food and things — about 300 of the emoji conversations actually use. Tap any of them and it is added to your message; tap the smiley again to close it. Opening the attachment sheet closes the panel, and opening the panel closes the sheet, so the two can never cover each other. Before this, adding an emoji meant going into your keyboard's emoji drawer, which on many Android keyboards is three taps deep.
